mechanism: Perampanel is a CYP3A4 inducer that may increase isotretinoin metabolism, potentially reducing its teratogenic effect, while isotretinoin may increase perampanel levels through CYP3A4 inhibition, elevating seizure risk.
action: Monitor seizure control closely; isotretinoin requires strict teratogenicity prevention protocols regardless; consider alternative antiepileptic if possible or increase monitoring frequency.
